knowledge.markdown:
# Knowledge Base: chebyshev-bounds-oq-01

## Problem Understanding

The PNT states π(x) ~ x/log(x). It is already axiomatized in PrimeNumberTheorem.lean with 8 axioms.
Full proof requires Tauberian theorems not available in Mathlib v4.26.0.

## Insights

- Upper bound on π(n) can be proved from primorial: primes > √n give (√n)^k ≤ n# ≤ 4^n
- Lower bound requires factorization bound C(2n,n) ≤ (2n)^{π(2n)}
- Factorization bound reduces to Kummer's theorem: carries ≤ log_p(2n)
- Mathlib multiplicity/factorization conversion is the main technical obstacle

## Dead Ends

- Cannot import PrimeNumberTheoremAnd project directly (version/dependency issues)
- Cannot prove full PNT without Tauberian theorems
- π(n) ≥ log₂(n) is too weak for a nontrivial lower bound on π(x)·log(x)/x
